commands: REMOTE=$(git remote get-url origin); printf 'AGENT_ORIGIN=%s\n' "$REMOTE"; case "$REMOTE" in https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller|https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|git@github.com:MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|ssh://git@github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git) ;; *) echo BOUND_REPO_MISMATCH; exit 42;; esac; REMOTE_MAIN=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}'); printf 'REMOTE_MAIN=%s\n' "$REMOTE_MAIN"; test "$REMOTE_MAIN" = "a07b5a14f4bb3ab8b8ca866aafb52a1390ef69ab"

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; test -d "$P/.git"; ORIGIN=$(git -C "$P" remote get-url origin); printf 'USER_CHECKOUT=%s\nUSER_CHECKOUT_ORIGIN=%s\n' "$P" "$ORIGIN"; case "$ORIGIN" in https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller|https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|git@github.com:MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|ssh://git@github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git) ;; *) echo BOUND_REPO_MISMATCH; exit 42;; esac

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; git -C "$P" fetch -q origin main; printf 'LOCAL_HEAD=%s
' "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)"; printf 'ORIGIN_MAIN=%s
' "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse origin/main)"; printf 'BRANCH=%s
' "$(git -C "$P" branch --show-current)"; printf 'AHEAD_BEHIND='; git -C "$P" rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/main; printf '%s
' '=== STATUS ==='; git -C "$P" status --short; printf '%s
' '=== LOCAL LOG ==='; git -C "$P" log -1 --oneline --decorate

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; printf '%s\n' '=== SCREENSHOT PATH CHECK ==='; for f in src/climate/ClimateApplication.cpp src/climate/application/ClimateApplication.cpp src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.cpp src/climate/application/ClimateIoAdapters.cpp src/climate/ClimateSemanticOutput.cpp src/climate/application/ClimateSemanticOutput.cpp src/climate/Stage28dLampSafety.cpp src/climate/LampSafety.cpp src/climate/Stage28dOutputBindings.cpp src/climate/OutputBindings.cpp src/climate/Stage28dBinaryRoleArbiter.cpp src/climate/compatibility/stage28d/Stage28dBinaryRoleArbiter.cpp src/climate/Stage28dRfOutputEndpoint.cpp src/climate/compatibility/stage28d/Stage28dRfOutputEndpoint.cpp src/climate/Stage28dThermalTestSequence.cpp src/climate/Stage28dThermalTestSequence.h; do if test -e "$P/$f"; then echo "PRESENT $f"; else echo "ABSENT $f"; fi; done

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; printf '%s
' '=== LOCAL TRACKED CLIMATE TOP LEVEL ==='; git -C "$P" ls-files 'src/climate/*' | awk -F/ 'NF==3{print}' | sort; printf '%s
' '=== CURRENT ORIGIN MAIN CLIMATE TOP LEVEL ==='; git -C "$P" ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main src/climate | awk -F/ 'NF==3{print}' | sort; printf '%s
' '=== CLIMATE DIFF LOCAL HEAD VS ORIGIN MAIN ==='; git -C "$P" diff --name-status HEAD..origin/main -- src/climate

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; printf '%s
' '=== ROOT FILE COUNTS ==='; printf 'LOCAL_HEAD_ROOT_FILES='; git -C "$P" ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD src/climate | awk -F/ 'NF==3' | wc -l | tr -d ' '; printf '
ORIGIN_MAIN_ROOT_FILES='; git -C "$P" ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main src/climate | awk -F/ 'NF==3' | wc -l | tr -d ' '; printf '
'; printf '%s
' '=== ORIGIN MAIN IMMEDIATE GROUP COUNTS ==='; git -C "$P" ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main src/climate | awk -F/ 'NF>=4{print $3}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr; printf '%s
' '=== STALE STAGE28D NAMES ON ORIGIN MAIN ==='; git -C "$P" grep -n -E 'Stage28d(LampSafety|OutputBindings|ThermalTestSequence)' origin/main -- src test scripts || true
